evidence.text: Can radial and angular motion of a wrapped probe D5-brane realize the all-heavy, rapidly turning inflationary mechanism?

sources.title: Systematics of multi-field effects at the end of warped brane inflation

evidence.text: Construct the F-term potential from the Kähler potential and embedding-dependent superpotential. Use the near-tip deformed-conifold metric for local canonical normalization, and analyze angular extrema and their Hessian.

sources.title: Combined local and equilateral non-Gaussianities from multifield DBI inflation

evidence.text: Import horizon-crossing field two- and three-point functions, selecting a short-wavelength Minkowski-like vacuum. Insert these into the δN bispectrum and trispectrum expansions, separating intrinsic quantum, classical local and mixed contributions; examine selected momentum-space limits.

sources.title: Fat inflatons, large turns and the $\eta$-problem

evidence.text: Integrate the full background, inspect mass and turn hierarchies, and apply the simplified spectra after checking the relevant entropy-sector diagnostics.

sources.title: Systematics of multi-field effects at the end of warped brane inflation

evidence.text: Apply the imported Lyth end-of-inflation mechanism and δN formalism to radial and light angular fields. Linear derivatives give the separate power contributions; higher derivatives are used to estimate fNL.

sources.title: Systematics of multi-field effects at the end of warped brane inflation

evidence.text: Integrate out σ adiabatically by placing it at the instantaneous minimum of the F-term plus positive uplifting potential. Approximate the otherwise transcendental stabilization equation through near-tip and inverse-volume expansions.

sources.title: Combined local and equilateral non-Gaussianities from multifield DBI inflation

evidence.text: Use the separate-universe δN expansion ζ = NA QA + NAB QA QB/2 + NABC QA QB QC/6 + … . The local expansion integrates H/φ̇ from φ* to an angular-dependent end surface φe = [φc² − (βΞ*/cs*)²]¹ᐟ².

sources.title: Non-Gaussianities in DBI inflation with angular motion

evidence.text: Can angular motion and entropy-to-curvature conversion make a concrete string-derived two-field DBI spinflation model compatible with compactification constraints and the Planck observations used in the paper?

sources.title: Universality in D-brane Inflation

evidence.text: Does six-field D3-brane inflation with hundreds of allowed potential terms exhibit inflationary statistics and trajectories robust to coefficient distributions, potential truncation and initial conditions? What predictions follow for the effectively single-field subset?

sources.title: Non-Minimal M-flation

evidence.text: Can nonminimal coupling to gravity improve matrix inflation's observational predictions, reduce the required D3-brane multiplicity, enable spectator preheating and alleviate excursions beyond the proposed UV cutoff?

sources.title: Prospects of inflation in delicate D-brane cosmology

evidence.text: Can radial D3-brane motion, coupled to a stabilized but evolving volume modulus, yield enough inflation and acceptable primordial spectra? The relevant tests are inflation duration, scalar amplitude, scalar tilt, and tensor amplitude within the model and observational conventions supplied by the paper.

sources.title: Stringy effects during inflation and reheating

evidence.text: Can strongly warped sectors in multi-throat string compactifications coexist with high-scale inflation, and can their string/KK physics affect inflationary fluctuations and Standard Model reheating?

sources.title: Prospects of inflation in delicate D-brane cosmology

evidence.text: The compactification setting asks how the position of a mobile D3-brane and the overall volume evolve together during inflation, after flux stabilization of other closed-string moduli.

sources.title: Warm warped throats

evidence.text: Can dissipation make moduli-stabilized radial and angular D3-brane inflation compatible with the observational constraints used in the paper, while retaining sub-Planckian excursions and, for angular inflation, a sub-Planckian effective decay constant?

sources.title: D-brane Potentials in the Warped Resolved Conifold and Natural Inflation

evidence.text: Can angular motion of a wrapped D5-brane near the warped resolved-conifold tip realize Natural Inflation with a Planckian decay constant while retaining control over backreaction?

sources.title: Cycling in the Throat

evidence.text: How does internal angular momentum change relativistic probe D3/anti-D3 trajectories in warped throats, and when do these trajectories induce bouncing or cyclic mirage cosmologies?

sources.title: Gauged M-flation, its UV sensitivity and Spectator Species

evidence.text: Does the light spectator spectrum lower the gravitational cutoff enough to invalidate gauged M-flation, and are its scalar inflationary trajectories stable within the proposed D-brane-motivated effective description?

sources.title: Spinflation with Angular Potentials

evidence.text: How do angular potentials induced by compactification affect DBI D3-brane trajectories and inflationary e-foldings when both the UV throat region and the smooth deformed-conifold tip are retained?

sources.title: Towards multi-field D-brane inflation in a warped throat

evidence.text: Can an Ouyang D7 embedding support sufficiently long radial slow-roll D3-brane inflation followed by angular instabilities, and what potential and kinetic terms govern the ensuing multiple-field evolution?

sources.title: Towards an Explicit Model of D-brane Inflation

evidence.text: Can a simple symmetric wrapped-brane embedding yield a stable radial path with locally small inflaton curvature? The Kuperstein cycle supplies an explicit holomorphic prefactor and a residual SO(3) symmetry.

sources.title: Spinflation

evidence.text: How does angular motion affect DBI brane inflation, its compatibility with local gravitational backreaction bounds, and the coupling of curvature and entropy perturbations?

sources.title: Monodromy in the CMB: Gravity Waves and String Inflation

evidence.text: Expand the wrapped D4 DBI action to two derivatives and canonically normalize its position field. The exact field map involves a hypergeometric function; the authors use numerical inversion for the full potential and asymptotic expansions for its quadratic and fractional-power regimes.

sources.title: D7-Brane Chaotic Inflation

evidence.text: Mirror symmetry relates the large-complex-structure Kähler potential to the axion-independent large-volume potential of the mirror fourfold. F-theory period expansions motivate polynomial brane dependence in the flux superpotential.

sources.title: Large field inflation from D-branes

evidence.text: Use the four-dimensional N=1 F-term potential V=e^K(K^{αβ̄}DαW Dβ̄W̄−3|W|²), the tree-level Kähler potential and a two-step moduli-stabilization expansion around an approximately supersymmetric vacuum.

sources.title: Higgs-otic Inflation and Moduli Stabilization

evidence.text: The authors expand the D7 DBI and Chern–Simons actions in space-time derivatives, integrate over the wrapped cycle, and include ISD and IASD background fluxes. Matching the resulting scalar potential to supergravity data determines the corresponding nonstandard kinetic term.

sources.title: Monodromy in the CMB: Gravity Waves and String Inflation

evidence.text: Estimate consistency through a Taylor expansion of the moduli potential, dimensional reduction of the brane gravitational field, compact-space source interactions, and curvature/string-loop corrections. These are author estimates of corrections and stability, rather than a complete explicit mass-spectrum calculation.

sources.title: D7-Brane Chaotic Inflation

evidence.text: Small-α,β expansions determine the brane minimum and canonically normalized mass. Expanding in real and imaginary displacements, eliminating the imaginary displacement perturbatively, and retaining cubic/quartic terms estimates departures from quadratic inflation.

sources.title: A Microscopic Limit on Gravitational Waves from D-brane Inflation

evidence.text: What microscopic limit on primordial tensors follows from the inflaton field range in warped D-brane inflation, and how do DBI dynamics and a quadratic potential affect that limit?

sources.title: Large Gravitational Waves and Lyth Bound in Multi Brane Inflation

evidence.text: Can detectable inflationary tensors coexist with a string-derived microscopic description whose energy and field variables remain interpretable? The proposed example is an assisted multi-M5-brane system with an effective single canonical inflaton.

sources.title: D-brane Potentials in the Warped Resolved Conifold and Natural Inflation

evidence.text: Can angular motion of a wrapped D5-brane near the warped resolved-conifold tip realize Natural Inflation with a Planckian decay constant while retaining control over backreaction?

sources.title: Monodromy Charge in D7-brane Inflation

evidence.text: Does the internal backreaction of charge induced on a moving D7-brane generate inflaton-dependent nonperturbative moduli potentials strong enough to obstruct Higgs-otic inflation?

sources.title: A no-go theorem for monodromy inflation

evidence.text: Can the Silverstein–Westphal geometric D4-brane monodromy mechanism admit a concrete compactification containing its static endpoint? The paper treats an appropriate vacuum at the inflaton minimum as a necessary first step toward embedding the dynamics.

Cosmic strings, KK relics and stretched-string populations

Relic abundances, decay times and final vacuum energy
regimes: End of inflation and post-inflationary evolution
Thermal dilution and preheating where specified

conventions: Inflationary perturbations and late relic signatures remain separate observables
includes: Cosmic-string radiation, semilocal defects and magnetogenesis connections

sources.title: Inflation from wrapped branes

evidence.text: Pull back the ten-dimensional fields, evaluate the D5 determinant, integrate the wrapped sphere and normalize the radial kinetic term. The simplified output applies to the specified unfluxed embedding with small NS correction.

evidence.text: Dimensional reduction of the ten-dimensional kinetic and Chern–Simons interactions uses T¹,¹ harmonics, literature KK spectra and normalized radial Bessel wavefunctions. Spin-dependent radial profiles determine whether UV or IR contributions dominate overlap integrals.

sources.title: Hybrid inflation and waterfall field in string theory from D7-branes

evidence.text: The effective theory matches magnetic masses to moduli-dependent FI terms and gauge couplings. Brane separation is represented by a trilinear superpotential, with physical Yukawa couplings and matter Kähler metrics determining F-term masses and quartic terms.

sources.title: Generation of electromagnetic fields in string cosmology with a massive scalar field on the anti D-brane

evidence.text: Use the asymptotic positive-frequency mode exp(−ikη)/√(2k) as φ̇ → 0, Bogolyubov coefficients and a particle-production integral. Estimate the super-Hubble spectrum by slow-roll analysis and matching inflationary and radiation-era solutions.
